description: This file defines the WorkScheduleService class within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It manages employee work schedules by dynamically instantiating work schedule implementation classes, with caching for efficiency, and handles potential configuration issues. The class interacts with configuration and class helper traits, logs errors, and works with WorkScheduleInterface implementations.

classes.name: WorkScheduleService
classes.description: Service class responsible for providing employee work schedule instances, handling dynamic class resolution, caching, and error handling within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getWorkSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches a work schedule instance for a given employee number, ensuring the class exists and implements the correct interface.
